================================================================================
第三方开源组件许可证汇总（THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt）
================================================================================

本产品（Windows 数据恢复软件）使用了若干第三方开源组件。按照各组件许可证的
要求，本文档汇总列出所使用的组件、对应许可证、以及许可证正文（或其获取方
式）。本文档对应 third_party/MANIFEST.md 里登记的组件清单与许可证分类，两
份文档配合阅读：MANIFEST.md 记录"为什么选这个组件、用什么方式集成（动态链
接/子进程调用等）"，本文档记录"对外分发时需要交付给用户的许可证文本本身"。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
重要说明（本文档的可信度边界，请在正式对外公开分发前认真对待）
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

本文档里的许可证正文，按来源分两类，可信度不同，已逐条标注：

【来源A：直接从本项目实际克隆/实际使用的上游代码仓库或工具链里的官方
  COPYING/COPYING.LESSER/LICENSE 文件原样复制】——这是最高可信度的来源，
  文本和上游项目分发时附带的完全一致，不是凭记忆默写。本文档里的
  LGPL-3.0-only 全文、GPL-2.0 全文、LGPL-2.1-or-later 全文、bzip2
  License 全文、PCRE2 附加豁免条款、Apache-2.0 的 LLVM 例外条款，均属于
  这一类——其中后四项是 2026-11-17（首次真正对外分发打包前）从本项目实
  际使用的 MSYS2 CLANGARM64 工具链 `/clangarm64/share/licenses/` 目录下
  对应包自带的官方许可证文件直接复制补全的，不再是占位的"待补全文"状态。

【来源B：标准许可证模板（MIT / BSD-3-Clause / Zlib License / Apache-2.0
  正文 / CC0 1.0）】——这几份是开源世界里最广泛使用、文本高度标准化的许
  可证，本文档按标准文本复现。可信度仍然高，但**不是从本项目实际依赖的
  那个具体二进制包里直接提取的官方副本**，正式对外公开分发前，建议抽查
  一两个关键组件（尤其是 Apache-2.0 这种篇幅较长的）核对一遍和上游项目
  官方仓库里的 LICENSE 文件逐字一致。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
目录
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
一、LGPL-3.0-only 组件及许可证全文（来源A）
二、GPL-2.0 组件（PhotoRec/testdisk 子进程）及许可证全文、分发要求（来源A）
三、LGPL-2.1-or-later 组件及许可证全文（来源A）
四、MIT License 组件及许可证全文（来源B）
五、BSD-3-Clause 组件及许可证全文（来源B，含 PCRE2 附加条款，来源A）
六、Zlib License 组件及许可证全文（来源B）
七、bzip2-1.0.6 License 组件及许可证全文（来源A）
八、Apache-2.0 组件及许可证全文（来源B，含 LLVM 例外条款，来源A）
九、CC0 1.0 组件
十、FreeType 强制信用声明（独立于上面任何一类，必须原文包含）
十一、尚未完成的合规事项

================================================================================
一、LGPL-3.0-only 组件（来源A：文本原样取自本项目实际克隆的上游仓库 COPYING.LESSER）
================================================================================

本许可证适用于以下组件（均以独立 .dll 动态链接集成，不静态编译进主 exe，
符合 third_party/MANIFEST.md 的 lgpl-dynamic 集成规则）：

  - libfsntfs（NTFS 文件系统解析引擎）—— third_party/lgpl-dynamic/libfsntfs
  - libfsfat（FAT/exFAT 格式解析辅助库）—— third_party/lgpl-dynamic/libfsfat
  - libvshadow（卷影副本离线解析）—— third_party/lgpl-dynamic/libvshadow
  - libbde（BitLocker 加密卷解密）—— third_party/lgpl-dynamic/libbde
  - libvsgpt（GPT 分区表解析）—— third_party/lgpl-dynamic/libvsgpt
  - libvsmbr（MBR 分区表解析）—— third_party/lgpl-dynamic/libvsmbr
  - ntfs_bfio_bridge.dll（本项目自行编译的 Windows-only 桥接 DLL，内含
    libfsntfs 发行包自带的 libbfio_handle.c 等原始源文件，未修改内容，
    详见 third_party/MANIFEST.md 对应说明；源代码本身仍然是 libfsntfs
    项目的 LGPL-3.0-only 代码，只是编译产物从一个 DLL 变成两个）
  - Qt 6（Core / Gui / Widgets / Multimedia 模块，经 MSYS2 CLANGARM64
    官方预编译包动态链接，未修改源码，详见 third_party/MANIFEST.md
    2026-11-06 核实记录——已确认这几个模块走 LGPL-3.0-only，不是 GPL-only）

  （libfsext：MANIFEST.md 登记为"预留未实际集成"，当前产品未编译/未分发
  这个库，暂不计入本分发清单；如果以后真正启用 ext2/3/4 支持，需要把它
  加进这份清单并补充版权声明）

动态链接场景下，上述组件对分发方的义务：提供本许可证全文（见下）；若修改
过库本身源码，需要公开修改部分（本项目均未修改源码，直接使用上游发行版）；
因为本来就是独立 .dll 运行时动态加载，"允许用户用其他兼容版本的库替换"这
条义务天然满足，不需要额外工作。

================================================================================
二、GPL-2.0 组件（来源A：文本原样取自本项目实际克隆的 testdisk 仓库 COPYING）
================================================================================

组件：PhotoRec / TestDisk（cgsecurity/testdisk，commit f9e57dc，
third_party/gpl-subprocess-only/testdisk）

集成方式（必须严格遵守，详见 third_party/MANIFEST.md）：**本项目未拷贝
testdisk/PhotoRec 任何源码进自己的工程**，只是把它编译成独立的
`photorec.exe`，由本产品以子进程方式调用（命令行参数驱动，解析其输出的
report.xml），未做任何修改。

对分发方（本项目）的义务，随 `photorec.exe` 一起分发时必须同时满足：
  1. 附带本许可证全文（见下）
  2. 保留 photorec.exe 原始的版权声明（PhotoRec/TestDisk 版权归属
     Christophe Grenier 及贡献者）
  3. 提供对应版本源码的获取方式——本项目使用的具体版本对应
     third_party/MANIFEST.md 登记的 commit f9e57dc，源码可从
     https://github.com/cgsecurity/testdisk （对应 commit）直接获取
  4. 不得对 photorec.exe 做任何修改后以"自己的工具"名义重新分发，除非
     修改版本本身也以 GPL 开源——本项目目前的构建方式（详见开发日志
     D5/D6 执行记录）是用官方 MinGW 配方原样编译，未修改 testdisk 任何
     源码，满足这一条

（third_party/MANIFEST.md 里同时登记的 tuxera/ntfs-3g 目前仅作架构参考，
没有被编译或分发任何产物，不适用上面这几条分发义务；如果以后真的编译并
分发 ntfs-3g 的任何可执行文件，需要补上同等的 GPL 分发声明。）

三、LGPL-2.1-or-later 组件（来源A：2026-11-17 从本项目实际使用的 MSYS2
   CLANGARM64 工具链 /clangarm64/share/licenses/libiconv/COPYING.LIB
   原样复制）
================================================================================

组件（均为 MSYS2 CLANGARM64 工具链的运行时依赖 DLL，不是本项目直接 clone
的代码）：

  - libiconv-2.dll
  - libintl-8.dll（gettext 项目同样采用 LGPL-2.1-or-later）
  - libglib-2.0-0.dll
  - libgraphite2.dll（三选一许可证，本项目按 LGPL-2.1-or-later 使用，
    另外两个可选项是 GPL-2.0-or-later / MPL-2.0，本项目明确选择
    LGPL-2.1-or-later，对外说明时要写清楚是这一个，不能含糊写"多选一"）

分发义务摘要：提供 LGPL-2.1 许可证全文（已内嵌，见下）；若修改源码需开源
修改部分（本项目未修改，直接使用 MSYS2 官方预编译包）；动态链接场景下
"允许替换库"的义务天然满足。

                            Preamble

  The licenses for most software are designed to take away your
freedom to share and change it.  By contrast, the GNU General Public
Licenses are intended to guarantee your freedom to share and change
free software--to make sure the software is free for all its users.

  This license, the Lesser General Public License, applies to some
specially designated software packages--typically libraries--of the
Free Software Foundation and other authors who decide to use it.  You
can use it too, but we suggest you first think carefully about whether
this license or the ordinary General Public License is the better
strategy to use in any particular case, based on the explanations below.

  When we speak of free software, we are referring to freedom of use,
not price.  Our General Public Licenses are designed to make sure that
you have the freedom to distribute copies of free software (and charge
for this service if you wish); that you receive source code or can get
it if you want it; that you can change the software and use pieces of
it in new free programs; and that you are informed that you can do
these things.

  To protect your rights, we need to make restrictions that forbid
distributors to deny you these rights or to ask you to surrender these
rights.  These restrictions translate to certain responsibilities for
you if you distribute copies of the library or if you modify it.

  For example, if you distribute copies of the library, whether gratis
or for a fee, you must give the recipients all the rights that we gave
you.  You must make sure that they, too, receive or can get the source
code.  If you link other code with the library, you must provide
complete object files to the recipients, so that they can relink them
with the library after making changes to the library and recompiling
it.  And you must show them these terms so they know their rights.

  We protect your rights with a two-step method: (1) we copyright the
library, and (2) we offer you this license, which gives you legal
permission to copy, distribute and/or modify the library.

  To protect each distributor, we want to make it very clear that
there is no warranty for the free library.  Also, if the library is
modified by someone else and passed on, the recipients should know
that what they have is not the original version, so that the original
author's reputation will not be affected by problems that might be
introduced by others.

  Finally, software patents pose a constant threat to the existence of
any free program.  We wish to make sure that a company cannot
effectively restrict the users of a free program by obtaining a
restrictive license from a patent holder.  Therefore, we insist that
any patent license obtained for a version of the library must be
consistent with the full freedom of use specified in this license.

  Most GNU software, including some libraries, is covered by the
ordinary GNU General Public License.  This license, the GNU Lesser
General Public License, applies to certain designated libraries, and
is quite different from the ordinary General Public License.  We use
this license for certain libraries in order to permit linking those
libraries into non-free programs.

  When a program is linked with a library, whether statically or using
a shared library, the combination of the two is legally speaking a
combined work, a derivative of the original library.  The ordinary
General Public License therefore permits such linking only if the
entire combination fits its criteria of freedom.  The Lesser General
Public License permits more lax criteria for linking other code with
the library.

  We call this license the "Lesser" General Public License because it
does Less to protect the user's freedom than the ordinary General
Public License.  It also provides other free software developers Less
of an advantage over competing non-free programs.  These disadvantages
are the reason we use the ordinary General Public License for many
libraries.  However, the Lesser license provides advantages in certain
special circumstances.

  For example, on rare occasions, there may be a special need to
encourage the widest possible use of a certain library, so that it becomes
a de-facto standard.  To achieve this, non-free programs must be
allowed to use the library.  A more frequent case is that a free
library does the same job as widely used non-free libraries.  In this
case, there is little to gain by limiting the free library to free
software only, so we use the Lesser General Public License.

  In other cases, permission to use a particular library in non-free
programs enables a greater number of people to use a large body of
free software.  For example, permission to use the GNU C Library in
non-free programs enables many more people to use the whole GNU
operating system, as well as its variant, the GNU/Linux operating
system.

  Although the Lesser General Public License is Less protective of the
users' freedom, it does ensure that the user of a program that is
linked with the Library has the freedom and the wherewithal to run
that program using a modified version of the Library.

  The precise terms and conditions for copying, distribution and
modification follow.  Pay close attention to the difference between a
"work based on the library" and a "work that uses the library".  The
former contains code derived from the library, whereas the latter must
be combined with the library in order to run.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

EXEMPTION FOR BINARY LIBRARY-LIKE PACKAGES

The second condition in the BSD licence (covering binary redistributions) does
not apply all the way down a chain of software. If binary package A includes
PCRE2, it must respect the condition, but if package B is software that
includes package A, the condition is not imposed on package B unless it uses
PCRE2 independently.

================================================================================
九、CC0 1.0 组件
================================================================================

组件：libb2-1.dll（三选一许可证，本项目按 CC0 使用，另外两个可选项是
OpenSSL License / Apache-2.0，本项目明确选择 CC0）

CC0 是"放弃一切权利/公有领域贡献"声明，不是传统意义上的开源许可证，没有
强制条款（不要求保留版权声明、不要求提供许可证全文），分发时无强制合规
动作。完整法律文本（Legal Code）可从
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode 获取，官方
通常展示的简短声明是：

  "CC0 1.0 Universal — No Copyright. The person who associated a work
  with this deed has dedicated the work to the public domain by waiving
  all of his or her rights to the work worldwide under copyright law,
  including all related and neighboring rights, to the extent allowed
  by law."

================================================================================
十、FreeType 强制信用声明（独立于上面任何一类，必须原文包含在分发物里）
================================================================================

组件：libfreetype-6.dll（二选一许可证，本项目按 FTL 使用，另一个可选项
是 GPL-2.0，本项目明确选择 FTL，这是唯一一条本次核实里发现的"必须包含指
定文字"的强制条款，不是可选鸣谢）。

对外分发物（产品"关于"页面、或随附的许可证说明文档）必须原文包含以下文
字，一字不改：

  "Portions of this software are copyright © The FreeType Project
  (www.freetype.org). All rights reserved."

FTL（FreeType License）全文可从 FreeType 官方仓库
https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/freetype/freetype 根目录的 LICENSE.TXT /
docs/FTL.TXT 获取；本文档未内嵌 FTL 全文（措辞是 FreeType 项目自定义的，
不是标准模板），但上面这句信用声明是其中唯一一条本项目已经确认的强制要
求，正式对外分发前必须单独核对落地到用户能看到的地方（不能只塞进一个没
人会打开的 txt 文件里）。

================================================================================
十一、尚未完成的合规事项
================================================================================

1. **[2026-11-17 已解决] 原"待补全文"的四处**（LGPL-2.1-or-later、
   bzip2-1.0.6、PCRE2 附加豁免条款、LLVM 例外条款）已在本次首次真正对外
   分发打包前，从 MSYS2 CLANGARM64 工具链 `/clangarm64/share/licenses/`
   目录下对应包自带的官方许可证文件原样复制补全（见上方一~八节，均已重
   新标注为"来源A"），不再是占位状态。
2. **本文档里标注"来源B"的几份标准模板**（MIT/BSD-3-Clause/Zlib
   License/Apache-2.0 正文）建议在正式对外公开分发前抽查核对一遍和官方
   发布文本逐字一致，尤其是 Apache-2.0 这种篇幅较长的——这条仍然保留，
   没有在这次一并核对。
3. **[2026-11-17 已解决] Qt 的 LGPL-3.0"告知用户使用了 LGPL 组件"这条
   义务**：GUI 的"关于"页面（`gui/main_window.cpp`
   `MainWindow::onAboutClicked()`）已补充 Qt 6/libfsntfs 等 LGPL-3.0
   组件说明、PhotoRec/TestDisk 的 GPL-2.0 子进程调用说明、以及 FreeType
   强制信用声明原文，并指向安装目录下本文档获取完整许可证全文，不再只
   是塞进一个没人会打开的 txt 文件。
4. **third_party/MANIFEST.md"待办"列表里尚未完成的事项**（本文档只解决
   其中"许可证全文汇总"这一条）：
   - 商用发布前，将 third_party/MANIFEST.md 和本文档交给熟悉 FOSS 许可
     的律师做一次正式审查（尤其是 sleuthkit CPL 模块的"模块化组合"边界
     判定——虽然目前产品代码里还没有实际使用 sleuthkit 的任何文件，这一
     条暂不紧迫，但清单仍然登记着这个组件，法务审查时应当一并确认）。
5. **本文档和 third_party/MANIFEST.md 的分工**：MANIFEST.md 记录"为什么
   选、怎么集成"，本文档记录"对外分发时交付给用户的许可证文本"；以后新
   增/移除任何第三方组件，两份文档都要同步更新，不要只改一份。
